(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the embryos in a non-destructive medium that does not comprise a chemical causing cell disruption__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water, and does not comprise a pH adjusting chemical.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __that facilitates the breakdown of cellular structures while maintaining embryo viability__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __utilizing PCR based techniques__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __through a genotyping process__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is __performed through a computerized evaluation system which may include automated features__.
